annotations.title: Compare recent sale prices across developments

description: Use this when a user wants to compare recent resale or transaction prices across many Singapore developments, such as the cheapest HDB streets in Tampines, the busiest condos in District 15, or which executive condominiums sold for the most per square foot. Pass market "hdb" for HDB resale flats by street, optionally with town, or "private" for condos and apartments by URA project, optionally with district and homeType; q narrows to street or project names containing it. Returns each development's number of sales, median price, median psf and latest sale over the latest 12 months of recorded sales, with its Homejourney page, ordered by sort and capped at limit (up to 50), plus the total matched. Landed homes are not covered. Use get_development_transactions for every sale in one development and get_hdb_block_summary for one HDB block.
name: get_development_price_summaries
